d: Short, chestnut brown hair with neat bangs and a smooth texture. Sharp, bright blue eyes framed by rectangular glasses on a youthful, adolescent face. A lean, slender build wearing a navy blue zip-up jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, white trousers, and black sneakers with white laces. A blue and yellow cape is draped over the shoulders, secured by a gold star brooch, and a long black staff is held against the shoulder.
